story.title: Coforge Q4 FY26 Profit More Than Doubles to Rs 612 Crore, Driven by AI Efficiencies and Deal Wins
story.summary: Coforge reported a 135% year-on-year surge in net profit to Rs 612 crore for Q4 FY26, surpassing street estimates, with strong revenue growth across healthcare and hi-tech verticals. The IT services firm attributed gains to AI-driven efficiencies and a robust pipeline of new deal wins. The result stands in contrast to the tepid growth reported by India's largest IT firms, suggesting mid-tier players are capturing AI-era benefits faster.
